texts.name: Geron
texts.biography: Geron stayed with the laborers at her birth, and she learned how to forge armor against demons. After being controlled by Technocracy, she became a general in the Foundry City.

specialty.description: Increases Speed of any Laborers or Overseers by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for 2 levels (rounded up).
specialty.name: Laborers
